about.title: About Us
about.text: Welcome to Polerinna – your home for Pole Dance in Munich. We offer classes for all levels, from beginners to advanced dancers. Our experienced instructors will guide you on your journey to greater strength, flexibility, and confidence.
about.values_strength_desc: Build muscle and discover your physical power
about.values_flexibility_desc: Improve your mobility and body control
about.values_community_desc: Become part of a supportive and inspiring community

classes.title: Our Classes
classes.subtitle: Something for Every Level
classes.beginner_desc: Perfect for those trying Pole Dance for the first time. Learn the basics safely and with fun.
classes.intermediate_desc: For dancers with basic knowledge – expand your repertoire and refine your technique.
classes.advanced_desc: Demanding choreographies and complex figures for experienced pole dancers.
classes.aerial_desc: Acrobatics and elegance on the aerial hoop – a beautiful alternative to Pole Dance.
classes.flexibility_desc: Stretching and mobility training to improve your range of motion.
classes.kids_desc: Age-appropriate classes for children and teenagers under professional guidance.

agb.title: Terms & Conditions – Polerinna Studio
agb.section1_text:
These Terms and Conditions apply to all services, courses and offers of Polerinna Studio.

By booking a course or membership, participants accept these Terms and Conditions.
agb.section2_text:
Registration for courses and services is done exclusively via the Eversports platform.

Each booking is binding and obligates the payment of the respective course fee.

A binding contract is concluded upon completion of the booking.
agb.section3_text:
Current prices are available on the Eversports booking platform.

Payment is made directly at the time of booking via Eversports.
agb.section4_text:
Cancellations are only possible via Eversports.

Free cancellation is possible up to 24 hours before the start of the course.

For later cancellations or no-shows, the booked unit is forfeited without replacement. Refunds or make-up sessions are excluded in this case.
agb.section5_text:
The studio reserves the right to cancel or reschedule courses if there are insufficient participants or for organisational reasons.

In the event of cancellation by the studio, a replacement date will be offered or the course fee will be credited or refunded.

Changes to the timetable will be announced in good time.
agb.section6_text:
Participation in courses is at participants' own risk.

Participants confirm upon booking that they are physically able to participate in training.

Participants must follow the instructions of the instructors.
agb.section7_text:
The studio is only liable for damages caused by intentional or grossly negligent conduct.

For simple negligence, the studio is only liable for the violation of essential contractual obligations.

No liability is assumed for personal belongings.
agb.section8_text:
Participants are obligated to treat the premises and equipment with care.

Endangering or disrespectful behaviour may result in exclusion from training.
agb.section9_text: Photo and video recordings are only permitted if other participants are not recorded without their consent and the course is not disrupted.
agb.section10_text: Information on the processing of personal data can be found in the separate privacy policy on the website.
agb.section11_text:
Should individual provisions of these Terms and Conditions be or become invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall not be affected.

The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies.
